findings.title: Modified config copy is discarded in monitor environment context
findings.body: get_monitor_environment_context copies monitor_environment.monitor.config into `config` and replaces `schedule_type` with the human-readable `get_schedule_type_display()` value, but the returned dict uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config` instead of `config`. As a result, issue occurrence event context still contains the raw schedule_type value and the intended display conversion is never used. Return `config` here (or stop creating the unused modified copy).
